tools.name: list_hospitals
tools.description: Returns the hospitals supported by the medprice.ai API, with their hospital_id (opaque DB key), EIN, name, locations, last_updated_on, and revision history (with per-revision has_payer_data). Supports pagination.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_hospital_chargemaster_cost" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
